round1: Marc and Ryan, one of two newcomers this year, tied for Round 1 at 19, and Jaclyn trailed everyone with 3. Only Stephanie picked Washington over Boston and Phoenix over Chicago, and she was right on both, while only Marc took the Kings over Vancouver.
round2: Marc led the round with 11 points, the only one to nail the Rangers in seven. Derrick picked the wrong team in all four series and scored 3 points, and Jaclyn picked every series in six games for the fifth time and got 2.
round3: Derrick and Nathan, the other newcomer, both picked New Jersey in six and Los Angeles in five exactly, for 24 points each. Marc, who had led the whole way, picked the Rangers and slipped to 7.
round4: Jaclyn and Nathan both nailed Los Angeles in six for 15 points each, and Nathan took the overall lead from Marc. Derrick backed New Jersey and has now picked the wrong Cup winner two years in a row.
overall: Nathan won the pool in his first year with 50 points, nine clear of Marc (41) and ten clear of Ryan (40), who was also in his first year. Stephanie finished last at 24, the sixth time she has done so. Marc has now picked the correct Cup winner four straight years and still came second, which is its own kind of heartbreak.
